description: This PHP source file defines the class OX_Extension_Delivery, which manages delivery hook caching, plugin dependency ordering, and related administrative tasks within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OX_Extension_Delivery
classes.description: A class extending OX_Extension_Common that handles delivery hook caching, dependency ordering, and plugin management tasks.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginInstall
methods.description: Executes tasks after plugin installation, currently calls parent method.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginUninstall
methods.description: Executes tasks after plugin uninstallation, currently calls parent method.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginEnable
methods.description: Executes tasks after plugin enable, caches delivery hooks.

methods.name: runTasksAfterPluginDisable
methods.description: Executes tasks after plugin disable, caches delivery hooks.

methods.name: runTasksOnDemand
methods.description: Runs cache delivery hooks on demand.

methods.name: _cacheDeliveryHooks
methods.description: Retrieves cached hooks and updates cache files.

methods.name: _saveComponentHooks
methods.description: Saves component hooks to configuration, returns success status.

methods.name: orderDependencyComponents
methods.description: Orders components based on dependencies for specific hooks.

methods.name: _generateDeliveryHooksCacheFile
methods.description: Generates cache file for delivery plugins.
